main_text.l: Ast hanc Albertus nubem medicúsque, sophós-que Sustulit ingenii dexteritate sui.
Maste ergo, ô iuvenis, Physicásque accingere ad artes, Hunc librum summa sedulitate legens.
Albertus fuerit Magnus, parvus tamen ecce Albertus, Magno (credite) maior adest.

page.notes: The first word of stanza two, printed "Maste" (long s), is uncertain and marked here only in this note: the reading could be "Macte" and should be checked against the scan. The printed "ingenij" was normalised to "ingenii" under the i/j rule. The ornamental mark above the heading and the diamond woodcut below the couplet are decorations, not text, and are not transcribed. The small ornamental stroke under the first stanza is also decoration. The faint text in the lower half of the page is show-through from the reverse and is excluded. The printed heading "IN EVNDEM" uses V for the vowel; it is rendered "EVNDEM" as printed, because the scan shows V in that position. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed.
